spanish: Y a estas se impurificarán; todo el tocante en su cadáver se impurecerá hasta la tarde.

findings.issue: אלה is a common plural demonstrative and the coreferent suffix on נבלתם is 3mp; «estas» selects feminine.

notes: 2mp hithpael as ustedes future and qal 3ms as singular inchoative stay within the tokens.
